ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and determine the extent of the fraud.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger issue with Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and potentially other states. By following the money, we may be able to determine who is involved in the fraud and how it is being carried out.
